scheme_name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for the Wards/Widows of Central Police Force Personnel
other_conditions: Wards and widows of Central Police Forces (CPFs) personnel who died in harness; wards of ex‑CPFs personnel disabled while on duty; wards of ex‑CPFs personnel who have received gallantry awards; wards and widows of ex‑CPFs/in‑service personnel below officer rank (up to Subedar Major/Inspector) are eligible
The scheme is open to widows and unmarried wards; marriage or remarriage later does not disqualify the applicant
Scholarship is limited to two children per family
Minimum 60% marks at the 10+2 level is required for the initial sanction; a minimum of 50% marks each year is required for renewal
Applicants must submit the application to the respective force Headquarters with the required documents and two self‑addressed stamped envelopes (27 × 12 cm)
Attested photocopies of supporting legal documents must be signed by a Gazetted Officer or Unit Commander of the CPFs
Each applicant must open an individual bank account in the designated bank and provide the account number in the application
A person cannot receive multiple scholarships for different programmes under this scheme
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹1,250 per month for boys and ₹1,500 per month for girls, payable for a duration of two to five years.
documents_required: Attested photocopies of supporting legal documents (attested by a Gazetted Officer or Unit Commander of CPFs)
Bank account details (account number in the designated bank)
